lessons.title: Reading · My new friends
lessons.en:
Hi! I'm Li Hua. I'm 13 years old. I live in Guangzhou, China. I am tall and thin. I have long hair. I am honest and friendly. I like playing the guitar and reading books. My favourite subject is English. I want to make friends with you. What about you?

Hello! My name is Anna. I come from Germany. I can speak German and a little English. I want to improve my English. I am patient and confident. I love hiking in the mountains. My elder brother is an engineer. My dream is to travel around China and meet new friends.
lessons.cn:
嗨！我是李华，13 岁。我住在中国广州。我又高又瘦，留着长发。我诚实友好，喜欢弹吉他和读书。我最喜欢的科目是英语。我想和你交朋友。你呢？

你好！我叫 Anna，来自德国。我会说德语和一点英语，希望提高英语水平。我很有耐心也很自信。我喜欢在山里徒步。我的哥哥是工程师。我的梦想是周游中国，结识新朋友。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Be & Have
lessons.en:
I am Li Hua. I am a student. I am from China.
She is Anna. She is from Germany.
My brother is an engineer. He is tall and friendly.
I have long hair. I have a big family.
Anna has short hair. She has a dream — to visit China.
We are classmates. We are good friends.

Are you a student? — Yes, I am.
Is he from Germany? — No, he isn't. He is from China.
Do you have any hobbies? — Yes, I do. I like playing the guitar.
lessons.cn:
我是李华，是一名学生，来自中国。
她是 Anna，来自德国。
我哥哥是工程师，他高大又友好。
我留着长发，有一个大家庭。
Anna 留着短发，她有一个梦想——去中国看看。
我们是同学，是好朋友。

你是学生吗？——是的，我是。
他是德国人吗？——不，他是中国人。
你有什么爱好吗？——有，我喜欢弹吉他。

lessons.title: More reading · A blog from Tom
lessons.en:
Welcome to my blog! I'm Tom. I'm 14 years old and I live in London. I have a big family — my parents, my elder sister and I. I am confident and I like making friends online.

My hobbies are playing football and singing. I am also good at grammar and I often help my classmates with English. My dream is to become a writer one day.

What is your name? Where do you live? What are your hobbies? Please write to me. I can't wait to read your story!
lessons.cn:
欢迎来到我的博客！我是 Tom，14 岁，住在伦敦。我家有爸爸妈妈、姐姐和我。我自信开朗，喜欢网上交朋友。

我的爱好是踢足球和唱歌，我的语法也不错，常帮同学学英语。我的梦想是有一天成为一名作家。

你叫什么？住在哪里？有什么爱好？欢迎写信给我，我迫不及待想读你的故事！

lessons.title: Reading · My school day
lessons.en: Hello, everyone. I am a junior high school student. I always get up at 6:30 a.m. I go to school on foot. School starts at 8 a.m. We have four lessons in the morning — English, Chinese, Maths and Geography. We have a break at 10 a.m. I usually have lunch at school. In the afternoon, we have two more lessons. School ends at 4:30 p.m. After school, I often play table tennis with my friends. I never go home late. I go to bed at 9:30 p.m.
lessons.cn: 大家好。我是一名初中生。我总是 6:30 起床，步行上学。学校 8 点上课。上午有四节课——英语、语文、数学和地理。上午 10 点休息一会。我通常在学校吃午饭。下午还有两节课，4:30 放学。放学后，我经常和朋友打乒乓球。我从不晚回家，9:30 上床睡觉。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Frequency adverbs
lessons.en:
always  100% → I always get up at 6:30.
usually 80% → I usually have lunch at school.
often   60% → I often play football after school.
sometimes 30% → Sometimes I go to the library.
seldom  10% → He seldom watches TV on school days.
never    0% → I never go home late.

Frequency adverbs come BEFORE most verbs but AFTER the verb "to be":
• I always ride my bike.
• She is never late for class.

Do you often ride your bike? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Is she usually at the market in the morning? — Yes, she is.
lessons.cn:
频度副词（强到弱）：always / usually / often / sometimes / seldom / never。
通常放在实义动词之前，但在 be 动词之后：
• I always ride my bike.  我总是骑自行车。
• She is never late for class.  她上课从不迟到。
你经常骑自行车吗？——是的。/ 不，我不常骑。
她早上通常在市场吗？——是的。

lessons.title: More reading · My mum's routine
lessons.en: My mum's day is very busy. She always gets up at 6 a.m. She goes to the market and buys fresh food. At 7 a.m. she makes breakfast for our family. She often reads the daily news on her phone while I eat. After breakfast, she rides her bike to work. She is a teacher, so she teaches four lessons every day. When the last bell rings, she comes home. In the evening, we sometimes read articles and practice English together. My mum never forgets to smile, even when she is tired.
lessons.cn: 我妈妈的一天非常忙碌。她总是早上 6 点起床，去市场买新鲜食物。7 点为全家做早饭。我吃饭时，她常在手机上看每日新闻。饭后，她骑车上班。她是老师，每天上四节课。放学铃响她就回家。晚上我们有时一起读文章、练习英语。即使累，妈妈也从不忘记微笑。

上.title: Unit 3 The Earth

words.example: The Earth is our home.
The Earth is a planet.
There are tall trees in the forest.

lessons.title: Reading · Our home, the Earth
lessons.en:
The Earth is our home. It is a beautiful planet. There are many forests and oceans on the Earth. There are many animals and plants, too. Animals live in the forests, in the oceans and on the ground. Plants give us fresh air.

But people pollute the Earth every day. They throw waste on the ground. They pollute the water in the oceans. They cut down trees in the forests. Many animals are in danger.

We must protect our home. We can reuse old books, reuse plastic bags, and recycle glass and paper. Let's keep the Earth clean and beautiful.
lessons.cn:
地球是我们的家园，是一颗美丽的行星。地球上有许多森林和海洋，还有许多动物和植物。动物生活在森林、海洋和陆地上，植物给我们新鲜空气。

但是人们每天都在污染地球：把垃圾扔在地上，污染海洋，砍伐森林，许多动物因此陷入危险。

我们必须保护家园——可以重复使用旧书和塑料袋，回收玻璃和纸张。让我们保持地球干净美丽。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · There be & prepositions
lessons.en:
There is a forest near my home.
There are many animals in the forest.
There is an old bridge over the river.
There are five tall trees near the school.

There isn't any waste on the ground.
There aren't any big factories in our town.

Is there a park in your city? — Yes, there is.
Are there any oceans in China? — Yes, there are.

Prepositions of place:
• The cat is under the table.
• The book is on the desk.
• The bank is between the hotel and the shop.
• My school is near the park.
lessons.cn:
There is/are 句型表示“某处有某物”。
There is a forest near my home. 我家附近有片森林。
There are many animals in the forest. 森林里有许多动物。
否定：There isn't / aren't …
疑问：Is / Are there …?
方位介词：in / on / under / between / near。

lessons.title: More reading · What can we do at home?
lessons.en:
Every family can help protect the Earth. Here are five easy ways:
1. Turn off the light when you leave a room.
2. Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth. Don't waste water.
3. Don't use too many plastic bags. Reuse your cloth bag every time you go to the market.
4. Put old paper, glass and plastic into different boxes so workers can recycle them.
5. Don't throw waste on the ground. Keep our streets clean.

If everyone does a little, our planet will stay beautiful for our children.
lessons.cn:
每个家庭都能为地球出一份力。以下五个小习惯：
1. 离开房间随手关灯。
2. 刷牙时关紧水龙头，不浪费水。
3. 少用塑料袋，每次去市场重复使用布袋。
4. 把旧纸、玻璃、塑料分类放入不同箱子，方便回收。
5. 不乱扔垃圾，保持街道干净。

只要人人出一点力，地球就能为孩子们保持美丽。

上.title: Unit 4 Seasons

words.example: There are four seasons in a year.
Flowers bloom in spring.
It is very hot in summer.
Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
Winter is the coldest season.
It is sunny today.
It is a rainy day.
Fly a kite when it is windy.
A snowy morning is beautiful.
Autumn is dry in the north.
The street is wet after the rain.
Wear a scarf in winter.
My gloves keep my hands warm.

lessons.title: Reading · Four seasons in a year
lessons.en:
There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

In spring, it is warm and windy. Flowers come out and trees turn green. We can fly kites in the park.

In summer, it is very hot and sometimes rainy. The days are long. We can swim in the sea or eat ice-cream.

In autumn, it is cool and dry. Leaves turn yellow and fall to the ground. Farmers are busy picking apples.

In winter, it is cold and snowy. Everyone wears a scarf and gloves. We can make a snowman and have hot soup at home.

Which season do you like best?
lessons.cn:
一年有四个季节：春、夏、秋、冬。

春天温暖多风，花儿开放，树木变绿，我们可以在公园放风筝。

夏天炎热，有时下雨，白昼长，我们可以去海里游泳，吃冰淇淋。

秋天凉爽干燥，叶子变黄落地，农民忙着采摘苹果。

冬天又冷又下雪，人人戴围巾、手套，我们可以堆雪人、在家喝热汤。

你最喜欢哪个季节？

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Present continuous
lessons.en:
The present continuous tense describes what is happening now.
Form: am / is / are + V-ing.

• Look! It is raining outside.
• The children are flying a kite in the park.
• I am wearing a warm scarf because it is snowy.
• We aren't swimming today — it is too cold.

Questions:
Is it snowing in Beijing now? — Yes, it is.
Are you making a snowman? — No, I'm not. I'm drinking hot tea.

Compare:
I often swim in summer. (habit → simple present)
Look, I am swimming now! (action in progress)
lessons.cn:
现在进行时描述“此刻正在发生”的动作：am/is/are + V-ing。
• Look! It is raining outside. 看！外面正下雨。
• The children are flying a kite. 孩子们正在放风筝。
否定：am/is/are not + V-ing。
疑问：Is/Are + 主 + V-ing?
对比：I often swim. (习惯，一般现在时) / I am swimming now. (现在进行时)

lessons.title: More reading · Seasons in Guangzhou
lessons.en:
Guangzhou is in the south of China. The weather here is different from the north.

Spring in Guangzhou is wet. It often rains and everything feels a little damp. We always carry umbrellas.

Summer is very long and hot. The days are sunny and bright. It is also rainy in the afternoon sometimes.

Autumn is short but very nice. It is cool and dry and the sky is blue.

Winter is warm. It is seldom snowy in Guangzhou. We often wear a light coat instead of thick gloves.

Because of the mild weather, Guangzhou is called "the city of flowers" — you can see flowers all year round!
lessons.cn:
广州在中国南方，气候与北方不同。

春天潮湿，常常下雨，我们总是带伞。
夏天很长很热，白天阳光灿烂，下午有时有阵雨。
秋天短暂却宜人，凉爽干燥，天空湛蓝。
冬天温暖，很少下雪，我们通常只穿薄外套，不用戴厚手套。

因为气候温和，广州被称为“花城”——全年都能看到鲜花！

words.example: The Moon goes around the Earth.
Astronauts work in space.
The rocket flew into the sky.
Yang Liwei is a Chinese astronaut.
A spacesuit protects the astronaut.
We stayed in a hotel in Beijing.
A bag full of feathers is light.
The plane will land at 3 p.m.
The Moon is about 384,000 kilometres away.
After the long trip he felt weak.
Open the window so we can breathe fresh air.

lessons.title: Reading · A trip to the Moon
lessons.en:
One day, we will travel to the Moon by rocket. The Moon is about 384,000 kilometres from the Earth. It is very quiet on the Moon — there is no sound at all.

There is no air on the Moon, so we must wear spacesuits to breathe. Our body feels very light there, because the Moon's gravity is weak. We can jump high and far.

When we land, we can stay in a space hotel. We can watch the Earth from the window. The Earth looks like a beautiful blue ball.

I hope I can go to the Moon someday and become an astronaut!
lessons.cn:
有一天我们将坐火箭去月球旅行。月球距离地球约 38.4 万公里。月球上非常安静，一点声音也没有。

月球上没有空气，我们必须穿航天服才能呼吸。因为月球引力弱，我们的身体感觉很轻，能跳得又高又远。

着陆后，我们可以住在太空旅馆，通过窗户看地球。地球像一个美丽的蓝色球体。

我希望有一天能登上月球，成为一名宇航员！

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Will & modal verbs
lessons.en:
Future with WILL:
• I will travel to the Moon one day.
• Rockets will be faster in 2050.
• She won't go alone.
Questions: Will you be an astronaut? — Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

BE GOING TO (a plan or decided action):
• We are going to visit a space hotel next week.
• He is going to read a book about rockets tonight.

Modal verbs:
• CAN = ability → I can see the Earth from here.
• MUST = necessity / strong rule → We must wear spacesuits on the Moon.
• SHOULD = advice → You should learn more about science.
lessons.cn:
一般将来时 WILL：表示“将要”。
• I will travel to the Moon. 我将去月球。
BE GOING TO：表示“计划”。
• We are going to visit a space hotel. 我们计划去参观太空旅馆。
情态动词：
• CAN 能力 — I can see the Earth.
• MUST 必须 — We must wear spacesuits.
• SHOULD 建议 — You should learn science.

lessons.title: More reading · Life as an astronaut
lessons.en:
Being an astronaut is hard work. Before a space trip, astronauts must train for many years. They learn how to fly a rocket, how to land safely, and how to fix problems in space.

In the space station, there is no up or down. Everything floats. Astronauts sleep in sleeping bags tied to the wall. They drink water from special bags and eat food from small packs.

From space, the Earth looks very small. Many astronauts say, "Now I know how important it is to protect our planet."

Astronauts are heroes. They show us that with courage and hard work, people can go anywhere — even to the Moon!
lessons.cn:
做宇航员并不轻松。飞上太空前，他们必须训练多年：学习驾驶火箭、安全着陆、处理太空故障。

空间站里没有上下之分，一切都会漂浮。宇航员睡在绑在墙上的睡袋里，用特殊袋子喝水，吃小包装食物。

从太空看，地球非常小。许多宇航员说：“我才知道保护这颗行星有多重要。”

宇航员是英雄，他们告诉我们：凭借勇气和努力，人类能到达任何地方——甚至月球！

words.example: China is a big country in Asia.
Beijing is the capital of China.
The Great Wall is famous all over the world.
We had a tour of the old city.
There are many tall buildings in the city.
The temple is very ancient.
Shanghai is a modern city.
The Imperial Palace is in Beijing.
Tokyo Tower is a famous tower.
The bridge is over the river.

lessons.title: Reading · Welcome to Asia
lessons.en:
Asia is a big continent. There are many countries in Asia. Each country has its own language, food and culture.

Beijing is the capital of China. It has many famous places, such as the Great Wall, the Forbidden City and the Summer Palace. Many people visit these ancient buildings every year. They are very beautiful and amazing.

Japan is a country in East Asia. Tokyo is the capital. It is a very modern city with many tall buildings. Tokyo Tower is a famous tower in Tokyo.

Thailand is a warm country in Southeast Asia. Bangkok is its capital. You can see many old palaces and eat delicious Thai food.

Asia is a wonderful place for a tour!
lessons.cn:
亚洲是一个巨大的大洲，国家众多，每个国家都有独特的语言、美食和文化。

北京是中国的首都，有长城、故宫、颐和园等名胜古迹。每年吸引众多游客，这些古建筑既美丽又令人惊叹。

日本是东亚国家，首都东京是一座非常现代的城市，高楼林立，东京塔是著名地标。

泰国是东南亚的温暖国家，首都曼谷，有许多古老的宫殿和美味的泰国菜。

亚洲是绝佳的旅行目的地！

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Facts & prepositions
lessons.en:
Simple present for facts:
• Beijing is the capital of China.
• The Great Wall stands in the north of China.
• Asia has many countries.

Proper nouns are capitalised:
• China, Japan, Thailand, Asia
• the Great Wall, the Forbidden City, Tokyo Tower

Prepositions of place:
• Bangkok is IN Thailand.
• The palace is ON the hill.
• Trains arrive AT the station at 8 a.m.
• Tourists come FROM all over the world.
• We travel TO Beijing next month.
lessons.cn:
一般现在时表示客观事实：
• Beijing is the capital of China. 北京是中国首都。
专有名词首字母大写：China / Asia / the Great Wall…
地点介词：in 国家里；on 山上；at 某车站；from 来自；to 去向。

lessons.title: More reading · A letter from Xi'an
lessons.en:
Dear Tom,

I am on a tour of Xi'an with my family. Xi'an is an ancient capital of China. More than 1,300 years ago, it was the largest city in the world.

Yesterday we visited the Terracotta Army. There are thousands of stone soldiers and horses in three big halls. Each soldier has a different face! It is one of the most famous places in Asia.

Today we walked on the old city wall. From the wall you can see both old buildings and modern towers. Then we crossed a small bridge and ate noodles at a local market.

I can't wait to tell you more stories when I come home.

Best wishes,
Lily
lessons.cn:
亲爱的 Tom：

我和家人正在西安旅行。西安是中国的古都，1300 多年前是世界上最大的城市。

昨天我们参观了兵马俑，三个大厅里有成千上万的石制士兵和战马，每个士兵的面孔都不一样！这是亚洲最著名的地方之一。

今天我们走上了古城墙，从上面能同时看到古建筑和现代塔楼；之后我们过了一座小桥，在当地市场吃了面条。

我迫不及待想回家告诉你更多故事。

祝好，
Lily

words.example: Our school has many clubs.
I want to join the Music Club.
She can dance very well.
I love to sing English songs.
He can draw a horse.
We play chess after school.
She plays the piano every day.
He plays the violin in the orchestra.
The little boy plays the drum.
I built a small robot with my team.
Science is an interesting subject.

lessons.title: Reading · Join a club!
lessons.en:
Our school has many clubs. Every Friday afternoon we can join different clubs. Here are some of the most popular ones.

The Music Club: If you can sing or dance, come and join us! We learn songs and have small shows every month.

The Art Club: We draw pictures and paint cartoons. Last week Tom drew a very funny robot.

The Chess Club: Chess makes you think fast. We play chess and have a school chess game every year.

The Science Club: We do science experiments. This term we are building robots and learning how they work.

Everyone has a talent. Come and show us yours!
lessons.cn:
我们学校有很多社团。每周五下午可以加入不同的社团。以下是最受欢迎的几个。

音乐社：会唱歌、跳舞的同学，快来加入！我们每月学唱歌曲，还会举办小型演出。

美术社：我们画画、画卡通。上周 Tom 画了一个很搞笑的机器人。

国际象棋社：下棋锻炼思维，每年都有校内比赛。

科学社：做科学实验。本学期我们在做机器人，研究它们的工作原理。

每个人都有才艺，快来展示吧！

lessons.title: Grammar focus · CAN & play + instruments
lessons.en:
CAN = ability
• I can sing but I can't dance.
• She can play the piano very well.
• Can you draw cartoons? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

PLAY + the + instrument (音乐乐器要加 the):
• play the piano / the violin / the guitar / the drum

PLAY + ball game (球类不加 the):
• play football / basketball / chess / table tennis

Would you like …? — polite invitation:
• Would you like to join the Art Club? — Yes, I'd love to.
• Would you like some tea? — Yes, please. / No, thanks.
lessons.cn:
CAN 表能力：
• I can sing. 我会唱歌。
• Can you draw? — Yes, I can. 你会画画吗？
play + the + 乐器：play the piano 弹钢琴；play the violin 拉小提琴。
play + 球类 / 棋类（不加 the）：play football / chess。
Would you like …? 礼貌邀请：Would you like to join the club? 你愿意加入社团吗？

lessons.title: More reading · My Robot Club diary
lessons.en:
Dear diary,

Today was a happy day. I joined the Robot Club after school. Mr Liu, our science teacher, showed us a small walking robot. Its legs moved like a real person!

We worked in small teams. My team has four members. I am not good at drawing, but I can write computer programs. My friend Sam is great at building, and Lily can draw beautiful plans for us.

We named our first robot "Star". It can turn its head and say "Hello". Next week we will teach Star to dance. I think Star is going to be famous at the school show!

I think I have found my favourite hobby.
Goodnight.
lessons.cn:
亲爱的日记：

今天很开心。放学后我加入了机器人社。我们的科学老师刘老师给我们展示了一只会走路的小机器人，它的腿像真人一样！

我们分成小组，我的小组有四个成员。我画画不好，但我会编程序。朋友 Sam 擅长搭建，Lily 能画漂亮的设计图。

我们给第一个机器人起名“Star（星星）”。它能转头并说“Hello”。下周我们要教 Star 跳舞，我觉得它将在校园演出上大放异彩！

我想我找到了最喜欢的爱好。
晚安。

words.example: I collect beautiful shells.
He has stamps from many countries.
This is a very old coin.
The baby loves his new toy.
She bought a paper fan in Hangzhou.
My grandma's ring is very valuable.
This bag is too expensive.
The fruit here is cheap and fresh.
Show me your stamp collection.
Please share the cake with us.
Put the letter in the envelope.

lessons.title: Reading · My hobby is collecting
lessons.en:
Many people have hobbies. My hobby is collecting stamps. I have more than 300 different stamps from different countries. They all come from the envelopes of letters.

Some stamps are expensive. For example, my favourite stamp is from 1980 — it is a small, bright red monkey. It is very valuable. Some stamps are cheap, but they are also beautiful. I keep all my stamps in a big book.

My grandpa taught me how to take good care of stamps. You should never touch them with dirty hands. You should keep them in a dry, cool place.

I like to share my collection with my friends. Collecting things makes me happy, and it also helps me learn about the world.
lessons.cn:
许多人都有爱好，我的爱好是集邮。我有来自不同国家的 300 多张邮票，它们都来自信件的信封。

有些邮票很贵，比如我最喜欢的是 1980 年的一张小小的红色猴票，很有价值；有些邮票便宜，但也很漂亮。我把所有邮票放在一本大册子里。

爷爷教我如何爱护邮票：不能用脏手触摸，应放在干燥阴凉的地方。

我喜欢和朋友分享收藏。收集东西让我开心，也帮我认识世界。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Plurals & opposites
lessons.en:
Most plurals just add -s:
• coin → coins, toy → toys, fan → fans

Words ending in -s, -x, -ch, -sh add -es:
• bus → buses, box → boxes, watch → watches

Some change the vowel or ending:
• man → men, woman → women, child → children
• knife → knives, leaf → leaves

Opposite adjectives:
• expensive ↔ cheap
• old ↔ new
• big ↔ small
• long ↔ short

Basic present perfect (first look):
• I have collected stamps for five years.
• She has kept that coin since 2020.
lessons.cn:
大多数名词复数加 -s：coin → coins。
以 s/x/ch/sh 结尾加 -es：box → boxes。
特殊：man → men，child → children，leaf → leaves。
反义词：expensive ↔ cheap，old ↔ new，big ↔ small。
现在完成时初识：I have collected stamps for five years. 我已经集邮五年了。

lessons.title: More reading · A world of collectors
lessons.en:
Around the world, people collect all kinds of things. Many young people collect stickers, small toys or cards from movies. Some adults collect old clocks, old books or old photos. A few rich people collect expensive paintings in big museums.

In China, many old people love to collect fans. Fans are not only useful in summer, but they also tell stories. A fan from Hangzhou may have a picture of West Lake on it. A fan from Sichuan may show a beautiful panda.

Last year, my aunt showed me her coin collection. The oldest coin is 200 years old! "Coins carry the story of our country," she said.

What do you collect? Whatever it is, share your collection and be proud of your hobby!
lessons.cn:
世界各地的人收集各式各样的东西：许多年轻人收藏贴纸、小玩具或电影卡片；有些成年人收集旧钟表、旧书或老照片；少数富人会在大博物馆里收藏昂贵的画作。

在中国，许多老人喜欢收集扇子。扇子不仅夏天有用，还承载故事——杭州扇子可能画着西湖，四川扇子可能有憨态可掬的熊猫。

去年姑姑给我看了她的硬币收藏，最老的一枚有 200 岁！她说：“硬币承载着祖国的故事。”

你收集什么呢？无论是什么，都请分享你的藏品，为自己的爱好感到自豪！

words.example: True friendship lasts forever.
I trust my best friend.
Good friends share everything.
Can you keep a secret?
Amy is kind to everyone.
A helpful friend is a treasure.
We seldom quarrel with each other.
Please forgive me for being late.
My friends support me when I am sad.
I promise to keep your secret.
We have been friends since childhood.
He is my table tennis partner.
My neighbour is very friendly.
I chat with my cousin online.
Listen carefully to your friends.

lessons.title: Reading · My best friend
lessons.en:
My best friend is Amy. We have known each other since childhood. We live in the same neighbourhood and go to the same school.

Amy is kind and helpful. When I feel sad, she listens to me carefully. When I have problems with my homework, she helps me. Last week, I lost my wallet at the market. Amy gave me some money for the bus.

We seldom quarrel. If we do, we forgive each other quickly. True friends share happy times and support each other in difficult times. I am lucky to have Amy as my best friend.
lessons.cn:
我最好的朋友是 Amy。我们从小就认识，住在同一个小区，上同一所学校。

Amy 善良又乐于助人。我难过时她会耐心倾听；我作业不会时她会帮忙。上周我在市场丢了钱包，她给了我坐公交车的钱。

我们很少吵架，即使吵了也会很快原谅对方。真正的朋友分享快乐、在困难时互相支持。能有 Amy 这样的好朋友我很幸运。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Present perfect tense
lessons.en:
Have / has + past participle is the present perfect tense.
I have known Amy for ten years.
She has been my best friend since childhood.
We have shared many happy moments together.
Has he finished his homework yet? — Yes, he has.
Have they ever quarreled? — No, they haven't.
I have already forgiven him.
She hasn't visited her grandma for a long time.
lessons.cn:
现在完成时：have / has + 过去分词。
我认识 Amy 十年了。
她从小就是我最好的朋友。
我们一起分享了许多快乐时光。
他作业做完了吗？——做完了。
他们吵过架吗？——没有。
我已经原谅他了。
她很久没去看奶奶了。

lessons.title: More reading · Friends online
lessons.en:
More and more students make friends online these days. My cousin lives in Beijing. We chat online every weekend. We share photos, music and school stories.

Online friendship is convenient, but we must be careful. Never give your real address or phone number to strangers. Never meet an online friend alone.

Good online friends are like good pen pals — they bring the world closer. But don't forget your friends around you. A smile in the classroom is still the warmest thing.
lessons.cn:
如今越来越多学生在网上交朋友。我堂姐住在北京，我们每周末都在线聊天，分享照片、音乐和校园趣事。

网上交友虽方便，但要小心：不要把真实地址或电话告诉陌生人，也不要独自约见网友。

好的网友就像笔友，让世界变得更近。但也别忘了身边的朋友——教室里的一个微笑，依然是最温暖的东西。

words.example: I love to travel in summer.
My uncle works abroad.
Don't forget your passport.
I booked two plane tickets.
My suitcase is very heavy.
We arrived at the airport at noon.
The flight to London takes 11 hours.
We joined a city tour in Paris.
I want to learn a foreign language.
Chinese culture is very rich.
I bought a souvenir in Beijing.
The British Museum is famous.
Italian pizza is delicious.
English is a world language.
Travelling gives me new experiences.

lessons.title: Reading · A trip to London
lessons.en:
Last summer, my family took a trip to London. We flew from Guangzhou to London. The flight took eleven hours.

We stayed in London for a week. We visited the British Museum and saw many old Chinese treasures. We took photos in front of Big Ben. We rode on the London Eye and enjoyed the beautiful view of the city.

London food is interesting. I liked the fish and chips very much, but I missed Chinese rice. The weather was cool even in summer, so I wore a jacket every day.

It was my first trip abroad. I learned a lot about British culture. I hope to visit more countries in the future.
lessons.cn:
去年夏天，我和家人去了伦敦。我们从广州飞到伦敦，飞行 11 小时。

我们在伦敦住了一周。参观了大英博物馆，见到了许多古代中国文物。我们在大本钟前拍照，坐伦敦眼俯瞰城市。

伦敦的食物很有意思，我很喜欢炸鱼薯条，但也想念中国米饭。即使夏天天气也很凉，我每天都穿夹克。

这是我第一次出国。我学到了很多英国文化，希望将来能游览更多国家。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Simple past vs present perfect
lessons.en:
Use simple past for finished actions with a clear time in the past:
I visited London last summer.
We flew to London two weeks ago.

Use present perfect for past actions connected to now (no specific past time):
I have been to London.
Have you ever tried fish and chips?

Compare:
I went to Beijing in 2023. (when = 2023, past)
I have been to Beijing three times. (up to now)
She has just bought a ticket.
He hasn't finished packing yet.
lessons.cn:
过去具体时间用一般过去时：
去年夏天我去了伦敦。
两周前我们飞到伦敦。

强调与现在的联系（不强调具体时间）用现在完成时：
我去过伦敦。
你吃过炸鱼薯条吗？

对比：
我 2023 年去了北京。（具体过去时间）
我去过北京三次。（截至现在）
她刚买了票。
他还没打包好。

lessons.title: More reading · Before you travel
lessons.en:
Travelling abroad is exciting, but preparation is the key. Here are some tips:

1. Book your flight and hotel early. Tickets are cheaper weeks before the trip.
2. Get your passport ready. Check the date — it should be valid for at least six months.
3. Learn a few words in the local language: hello, thank you, how much. Locals will smile at you.
4. Pack light but smart. Bring a jacket, comfortable shoes and a power adapter.
5. Respect the local culture. Different countries have different customs.

Remember, the best souvenir is your memory. Take photos, write a diary and share your stories with friends back home!
lessons.cn:
出国旅行令人兴奋，但准备工作很关键：

1. 尽早订机票和酒店，提前几周更便宜。
2. 准备好护照，有效期至少还要 6 个月。
3. 学几句当地语言：你好、谢谢、多少钱，当地人会对你微笑。
4. 轻装上阵但要周全：夹克、舒适的鞋、转换插头。
5. 尊重当地文化，各国风俗不同。

别忘了：最好的纪念品是回忆。多拍照、写日记，把故事分享给家里的朋友！

words.example: Pandas are lovely animals.
Tigers live in the wild.
We must protect endangered animals.
The panda is no longer endangered.
Illegal hunters kill many animals.
Many animals live in the forest.
Pollution destroys animal habitats.
There are many fish species in the sea.
Dinosaurs are extinct.
Show kindness to all animals.
We care for stray cats in our school.
We visited the zoo last Sunday.
Dolphins are clever animals.
Dogs are loyal friends.
We want a peaceful world for animals.

lessons.title: Reading · A dog called Lucky
lessons.en:
Three years ago, we found a small dog on the street. He was wet, cold and hungry. My dad carried him home. We called him Lucky.

Lucky is very clever. He can shake hands, sit and even open the door. He waits by the window every afternoon when I come home from school. He is my loyal friend.

Last year, Lucky saved my little brother. My brother ran to the street to catch a ball. A car came fast. Lucky ran after him and pushed him back. The car missed them both!

Animals have feelings. They can be our true friends if we show them kindness.
lessons.cn:
三年前，我们在街上发现一只小狗，又湿又冷又饿。爸爸把它抱回家，我们给它取名 Lucky。

Lucky 很聪明，会握手、坐下，甚至会开门。每天下午我放学回家，它都在窗边等我，是我忠诚的朋友。

去年 Lucky 救了我弟弟一命。弟弟跑到街上去捡球，一辆车飞驰而来，Lucky 追过去把他推回来，两人都毫发无损！

动物也有感情。只要我们对它们好，它们就会成为我们真正的朋友。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Passive voice
lessons.en:
Passive voice: be + past participle, used when the doer is unknown or not important.
Many animals are protected by law.
Pandas are loved by people all over the world.
The little dog was found on the street.
Food is given to the pets every morning.
Forests are being destroyed every day.
This species has been saved.

Active: People protect pandas.
Passive: Pandas are protected by people.
lessons.cn:
被动语态：be + 过去分词，强调动作承受者。
许多动物受到法律保护。
熊猫受到全世界人民的喜爱。
这只小狗是在街上被发现的。
每天早上给宠物喂食。
森林每天都在被破坏。
这个物种已经被拯救了。

主动：人们保护熊猫。
被动：熊猫受到人们的保护。

lessons.title: More reading · Save the pandas
lessons.en:
The giant panda is a symbol of China. Pandas live in the bamboo forests of Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu. They eat about 12 kilograms of bamboo every day.

In the 1980s, there were only about 1,000 wild pandas. Their habitat was cut down by people. Many pandas died of hunger.

Now, the Chinese government has built many panda reserves. Trees are planted again and hunters are not allowed. In 2021, the wild panda population reached over 1,800. Pandas are no longer on the "endangered" list.

Every one of us can help. Don't buy things made from wild animals. Tell your friends to protect nature. The panda's story shows that together we can save the future of our animal friends.
lessons.cn:
大熊猫是中国的象征。它们生活在四川、陕西和甘肃的竹林里，每天吃约 12 公斤竹子。

上世纪 80 年代，野生大熊猫仅约 1000 只。栖息地被砍伐，许多熊猫饿死。

如今中国政府建了许多熊猫保护区，重新植树，禁止狩猎。2021 年野生大熊猫数量超过 1800 只，已从濒危名录移除。

我们每个人都能出力：不买野生动物制品，告诉朋友保护自然。大熊猫的故事告诉我们：团结起来，就能守护动物朋友的未来。

words.example: There are many old trees in the park.
We plant trees every March.
Don't cut down the trees.
Trees give us oxygen.
A clean environment is important.
Pollution harms our health.
The desert is getting larger.
We sat in the shade of a big tree.
The roots of this tree are very long.
The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
Birds build nests on branches.
Paper is made from trees.
Please recycle your old books.
We must reduce paper waste.
Actions speak louder than words.

lessons.title: Reading · Why trees matter
lessons.en:
Trees are the oldest and tallest living things on Earth. Some trees can live for thousands of years.

Trees are very important to us. They give us oxygen and clean the air. They also give shade in summer and keep the soil safe with their long roots. Without trees, strong rain can wash away the land and deserts grow bigger.

Many animals and birds live on trees. Monkeys jump between branches. Birds build nests in the leaves. A forest without trees is like a city without people.

Sadly, humans cut down many trees every day. We need wood for paper, chairs and houses. But if we keep cutting, one day there will be no forests left.
lessons.cn:
树是地球上最古老、最高大的生命，有些树可以活几千年。

树对我们极其重要：提供氧气、净化空气，夏天遮阴，发达的根系保护土壤。没有树，暴雨会冲走土地，沙漠会越变越大。

许多动物鸟类依树而生：猴子在枝头跳跃，鸟儿在叶间筑巢。没有树的森林就像没有人的城市。

遗憾的是，人类每天都在砍树，为了造纸、做椅子、盖房子。如果一直砍下去，终有一天森林将不复存在。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Conditionals (If...)
lessons.en:
Type 1: real future condition — If + present, will + verb.
If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.
If you cut down forests, deserts will grow.

Type 2: unreal present condition — If + past, would + verb.
If I were a tree, I would live for a thousand years.
If there were no trees, many animals would die.

Useful tips:
- Don't use 'will' after 'if' in Type 1.
- Use 'were' (not 'was') after 'if' in Type 2 for all subjects.
lessons.cn:
第一条件句（真实未来）：If + 一般现在时, will + 动词。
如果我们多种树，空气会更洁净。
如果你砍伐森林，沙漠会扩大。

第二条件句（非真实现在）：If + 过去时, would + 动词。
如果我是一棵树，我能活一千年。
如果没有树，许多动物会死。

小贴士：
- 第一条件 if 从句里不用 will。
- 第二条件所有人称都用 were。

lessons.title: More reading · One tree, one life
lessons.en:
Every March 12th is Tree Planting Day in China. Students from all over the country plant young trees in parks, schools and hills.

Our school planted 200 trees last spring. Each class looked after ten trees. We gave them water every week and checked their leaves. By the end of summer, the young trees were strong and tall.

You don't need to wait for Tree Planting Day. You can help trees every day:
• Use both sides of the paper.
• Say no to paper napkins when you have a handkerchief.
• Recycle old books and boxes.
• Tell your family to reduce paper waste.

One tree, one life. Every small action counts. Let's bring more green to our planet.
lessons.cn:
每年 3 月 12 日是中国植树节。全国学生走进公园、校园、山坡种下小树苗。

去年春天我校种下 200 棵树，每班负责 10 棵。我们每周浇水、查看叶子。到夏天结束时，小树已茁壮成长。

不必等到植树节，每天都可以护树：
• 纸张两面使用
• 有手帕就不用纸巾
• 回收旧书和纸箱
• 告诉家人减少浪费

一棵树就是一条生命。每一个小行动都有意义，让我们为地球添一抹绿。

words.example: We drink water every day.
Don't waste water.
Save water, save life.
The Pearl River runs through Guangzhou.
The Pacific Ocean is huge.
West Lake is very famous.
The mountain spring is pure.
The river is badly polluted.
Every drop of water counts.
Please turn off the tap.
There is a water shortage in the north.
Boil the water before drinking.
The water pipe is broken.
The park has a beautiful fountain.
Water is necessary for all life.

lessons.title: Reading · A day without water
lessons.en:
It was Sunday morning. I turned on the tap to brush my teeth, but no water came out! I ran to the kitchen — the same! My mum said, "The water pipes are being repaired today. We will have no water until the evening."

What a day! I couldn't wash my face or flush the toilet. I used a small bottle of water to brush my teeth. At lunchtime, Mum bought some noodles from a restaurant because we couldn't cook at home.

In the afternoon, I was very thirsty. I went to the shop and bought a big bottle of water. It cost 5 yuan. I drank it slowly.

When the water came back at 8 p.m., I was so happy. I filled a glass and drank carefully. I finally understood: every drop of water is precious.
lessons.cn:
周日早上，我打开水龙头刷牙——没水！跑到厨房也没水。妈妈说：“今天修水管，要到晚上才有水。”

真难熬的一天！不能洗脸、冲厕所。我用一小瓶水刷牙。午饭时妈妈去餐馆买了面条，因为家里没法做饭。

下午我渴极了，去商店买了一大瓶水花了 5 元，一小口一小口地喝。

晚上 8 点水来了，我开心极了，倒了一杯水，小心翼翼地喝。那一刻我才明白：每一滴水都很珍贵。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Should / must / mustn't
lessons.en:
Use should to give advice — it's a good idea.
We should turn off the tap when brushing our teeth.
You should drink at least six glasses of water every day.

Use must to show necessity — you have to.
We must protect our rivers from pollution.
You must boil the water before drinking.

Use mustn't to show prohibition — don't do it.
We mustn't throw rubbish into the river.
You mustn't waste water, even one drop.

Compare:
should = a good idea
must = necessary
mustn't = forbidden
lessons.cn:
should 表建议——这样做更好：
刷牙时应该关上水龙头。
每天至少应喝六杯水。

must 表必须：
我们必须保护河流免受污染。
饮用水必须煮沸。

mustn't 表禁止：
禁止向河里扔垃圾。
不能浪费一滴水。

对比：should=建议，must=必须，mustn't=禁止。

lessons.title: More reading · Water around the world
lessons.en:
Our Earth is called the "Blue Planet" because 71% of its surface is water. But only 3% of all water is fresh, and most of it is locked in ice. Only about 1% of the water on Earth can be used by people.

In some parts of Africa, children walk 5 kilometres every morning to get a bucket of dirty water. In Northwest China, farmers save rain water in big jars for the whole year.

Here are some ways to save water:
• Take showers instead of baths.
• Wash vegetables in a basin, not under a running tap.
• Use the washing machine only when it is full.
• Fix leaking taps quickly.

A small drop of water may not seem important. But if everyone saves one drop a day, we can save millions of drops together. Water is the source of life — let's protect it for our children.
lessons.cn:
地球被称为“蓝色星球”，因为 71% 的表面是水。但淡水仅占 3%，其中大部分还被冰锁住，只有约 1% 可供人类使用。

非洲有些地方的孩子每天要走 5 公里去取一桶脏水。中国西北，农民把雨水储在大缸里供全年使用。

节水小妙招：
• 用淋浴代替盆浴
• 用盆洗菜，别开着水龙头
• 洗衣机装满再开
• 漏水的龙头及时修

一滴水似乎微不足道，但如果人人每天节约一滴，就是千千万万滴。水是生命之源，让我们为子孙后代保护好它。

words.example: Electricity is very important in our life.
The power went out last night.
Switch off the light when you leave.
My phone battery is dead.
I need to charge my phone.
Solar energy is clean.
Wind can produce electricity.
Save energy, save money.
Electricity can be dangerous.
Never touch broken wires.
The light bulb has burnt out.
Turn on the fan, it's hot.
Many machines use electricity.
Edison invented the light bulb.
Modern life needs electricity.

lessons.title: Reading · A night without power
lessons.en:
Last Friday evening, there was a big storm. Suddenly, all the lights went out. My family was having dinner in the dark. Dad found some candles and lit them one by one.

Without electricity, everything stopped. The TV was off. The fridge was warm. My computer game was gone. I couldn't even charge my phone. But we had a lovely dinner by candlelight. Mum told old stories and Dad sang songs from his childhood.

The power came back at midnight. Suddenly the room was bright again. I turned on my phone and saw many messages from my friends — they were in the dark too.

That night, I learned how much our modern life needs electricity. And I also learned that family time is more important than any screen.
lessons.cn:
上周五晚有场大风雨，突然停电了。我们一家在黑暗中吃饭。爸爸找来蜡烛一支支点亮。

没电，一切都停了：电视黑了、冰箱不凉、游戏玩不了，连手机都充不了电。但我们在烛光下吃了一顿温馨的晚饭，妈妈讲老故事，爸爸唱童年歌谣。

午夜来电了，房间重新变亮。我打开手机，满屏都是朋友的消息——原来大家都停电了。

那晚我懂了两件事：现代生活多么依赖电；家人相伴比任何屏幕都重要。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Past continuous tense
lessons.en:
Past continuous: was / were + verb-ing. It shows an action in progress at a past moment.
I was watching TV when the power went out.
They were having dinner when the lights came back.
At 8 p.m. last night, I was doing my homework.

It is often used with 'when' or 'while':
While Dad was lighting candles, Mum was telling stories.
When I was charging my phone, the power cut off.

Questions and negatives:
Were you reading at 9 p.m.? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
I wasn't sleeping. I was still studying.
lessons.cn:
过去进行时：was/were + v-ing，表示过去某刻正在进行的动作。
停电时我正在看电视。
灯亮起来时他们正在吃饭。
昨晚 8 点我正在写作业。

常配 when / while：
爸爸在点蜡烛时，妈妈正在讲故事。
我在给手机充电时停电了。

疑问和否定：
晚上 9 点你在看书吗？——是/不是。
我没在睡觉，还在学习。

lessons.title: More reading · Clean energy for the future
lessons.en:
Where does our electricity come from? For many years, most electricity came from burning coal. Coal is cheap, but it pollutes the air and warms our planet.

Today, scientists are looking for clean energy. Here are three green friends:

1. Solar power — Sunlight can be turned into electricity by solar panels. In sunny places like Qinghai and Inner Mongolia, huge solar farms light up thousands of homes.

2. Wind power — Strong winds turn giant windmills. In Gansu, there is one of the biggest wind farms in the world.

3. Water power — Fast rivers can spin turbines. China's Three Gorges Dam is the largest water power station.

At home, you can help too. Switch off the lights when you leave a room. Unplug chargers when your phone is full. Use LED bulbs instead of old ones. Clean energy is the future, and the future begins with each of us.
lessons.cn:
我们的电从哪里来？很长一段时间，大部分电来自燃煤。煤便宜，但污染空气、加剧气候变暖。

如今科学家在找清洁能源：

1. 太阳能——太阳能板把阳光变成电。青海、内蒙古等阳光充足之地建有巨型光伏电站，为千家万户点亮灯火。

2. 风能——大风转动巨型风车。甘肃有世界最大的风电场之一。

3. 水能——湍急的河水带动涡轮。中国三峡大坝是世界最大的水电站。

在家你也能出力：离开房间随手关灯；手机充满就拔充电器；用 LED 代替老灯泡。清洁能源是未来，未来从我们每个人开始。

words.example: I wrote a poem for my mother.
Li Bai is a great Chinese poet.
"Star" and "far" rhyme.
This poem has eight lines.
Each verse has four lines.
The poem is very beautiful.
This poem uses simple words.
The moon shines at night.
I had a strange dream last night.
The night is silent.
The wind whispers in the trees.
Poems express feelings.
Share your feelings with friends.
I love my family.
This poem brings back happy memories.

lessons.title: Reading · My favourite poem
lessons.en:
I love reading poems. A good poem is like a song — short, beautiful, and full of feeling.

My favourite poem is Quiet Night Thoughts by Li Bai. It has only four short lines, but it touches every Chinese heart. It says: in the quiet night, the moonlight on the floor looks like frost. The poet looks up at the moon and then down, missing his home far away.

I like this poem because it is simple but deep. When I am far from home at summer camp, I remember these lines. The moon looks the same in every city, so I know my family is with me under the same moon.

Poems are small, but they carry big dreams. Try writing one of your own!
lessons.cn:
我喜欢读诗。好诗如歌，短小、美丽、饱含情感。

我最喜欢李白的《静夜思》。只有短短四行，却触动每个中国人的心：静夜里地上的月光仿佛白霜，诗人抬头望月，低头思念远方的家乡。

我喜欢这首诗，因为简单却深刻。去夏令营远离家时，我就想起这些诗句——月亮在每座城市都是一样的，所以家人都和我共享同一轮月亮。

诗很小，承载的梦却很大。试着写一首属于你自己的吧！

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Attributive clauses with that / which / who
lessons.en:
An attributive clause gives more information about a noun (the antecedent).

1) who / that → for people:
The poet who wrote this poem is Li Bai.
The girl that sits next to me loves poems.

2) which / that → for things:
The poem which I like most is Quiet Night Thoughts.
This is the book that Mum gave me.

3) Leave out 'that / which' when it is the object:
The poem (that) I read last night was beautiful.
The song (which) we heard made me cry.

Tips:
- 'that' can replace both 'who' and 'which' in most cases.
- Keep the clause close to the noun it describes.
lessons.cn:
定语从句用来修饰前面的名词。

1) who / that——指人：
写这首诗的诗人是李白。
坐在我旁边的女孩喜欢诗。

2) which / that——指物：
我最喜欢的诗是《静夜思》。
这是妈妈送我的书。

3) 作宾语时 that/which 可省略：
我昨晚读的那首诗很美。
我们听的那首歌让我流泪。

小贴士：
- 大多情况下 that 可代替 who/which。
- 从句要紧跟它修饰的名词。

lessons.title: More reading · Writing your first poem
lessons.en:
Everyone can write poems. You don't need to be a famous poet. Here is a simple recipe:

Step 1: Choose a feeling or memory. It can be happy, sad, lonely, or excited.
Step 2: Close your eyes and think of images. What do you see, hear or smell?
Step 3: Write three or four short lines. Don't worry about long words.
Step 4: Try to make the ending rhyme, or leave it free.

Here is a small poem by a student:
The river whispers softly at night,
The moon is round, the stars are bright.
I miss my grandma far away,
I hope to see her on my birthday.

A poem is a photo of your heart. Keep a small notebook and write one every week. Soon you will have a colourful book of your own dreams.
lessons.cn:
人人都能写诗，不必是著名诗人。简单四步：

1. 选一个感受或记忆：开心、难过、孤独、兴奋都行。
2. 闭上眼，想想画面：你看到、听到、闻到什么？
3. 写三四短行，不用长词。
4. 尝试让结尾押韵，或不押也行。

一位同学写的小诗：
夜晚河水低声轻吟，
月儿圆圆，星光明。
想念远方的奶奶，
生日愿能再相见。

诗是心灵的快照。准备一本小本子，每周写一首，不久你就会有一整本属于自己的彩色梦。

words.example: Drawing is my favourite hobby.
She has a great career as a doctor.
Follow your interest.
Cooking is a useful skill.
Practice makes perfect.
Success needs hard work.
I dream of being a pilot.
The future is in your hands.
He wants to be a chef.
A designer needs creativity.
The photographer took amazing pictures.
Engineers build bridges.
Teachers share knowledge.
A creative mind is priceless.
Passion leads to success.

lessons.title: Reading · From a small kitchen to a big stage
lessons.en:
Chef Liu is a famous cook in Guangzhou. But twenty years ago, cooking was just his hobby.

When he was a boy, he loved watching his grandmother cook. He tried his first fried egg at the age of eight. He burned it, but he kept trying. Every weekend, he cooked for his family. His friends loved eating at his house.

After high school, he went to a cooking school. It was hard work — he practised every day from early morning to late night. Ten years later, he opened his own small restaurant. Now his restaurant is in a five-star hotel, and he teaches young cooks on TV.

"Start from what you love," Chef Liu says. "A hobby today can be your career tomorrow. But remember — you need passion and practice every single day."
lessons.cn:
刘大厨是广州有名的厨师。但二十年前，做饭只是他的爱好。

小时候他爱看奶奶做饭，8 岁时煎了第一个煎蛋——煎糊了，但他一直尝试。每个周末他为家人做饭，朋友们都爱来他家吃饭。

高中毕业后他上烹饪学校，每天从清晨练到深夜。十年后开了自己的小餐馆。如今餐馆开在五星级酒店，他还在电视上教年轻厨师。

他说：“从你热爱的事开始。今天的爱好可能是明天的事业，但记住——每一天都需要热情和练习。”

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Gerunds and infinitives
lessons.en:
Gerund: verb + -ing, used as a noun.
Cooking is his hobby.
I enjoy reading poems.

Infinitive: to + verb.
He wants to be a chef.
It is fun to learn new skills.

Useful patterns:
1) After these verbs use gerund: enjoy, finish, practise, mind, avoid.
   I finished doing my homework.
   She enjoys singing.

2) After these verbs use infinitive: want, hope, plan, decide, promise.
   I hope to visit London.
   They decided to help.

3) Both OK (with different meaning sometimes): like, love, start, begin, stop.
   I stopped to eat. (I stopped in order to eat.)
   I stopped eating. (I don't eat any more.)
lessons.cn:
动名词（v-ing 作名词）：
做饭是他的爱好。
我喜欢读诗。

不定式（to + v）：
他想成为厨师。
学新技能很有趣。

常见搭配：
1) 只接动名词：enjoy, finish, practise, mind, avoid。
   我写完作业了。
   她喜欢唱歌。

2) 只接不定式：want, hope, plan, decide, promise。
   我希望访问伦敦。
   他们决定帮忙。

3) 两者都可（含义可能不同）：like, love, start, begin, stop。
   我停下来吃饭（为了吃饭停）
   我不吃了（停止吃饭的动作）

lessons.title: More reading · Find your own path
lessons.en:
What job will you do in ten years? Maybe you don't know yet. That's okay — most teenagers don't.

Here are four steps to find your path:

1) Discover. Try many things: sports, music, cooking, coding, drawing. You never know what you love until you try.

2) Focus. When something makes your heart beat faster, spend more time on it. An hour a day is enough at the beginning.

3) Learn. Read books, watch videos, ask teachers. Every skill has rules and tricks.

4) Share. Show your work to friends. Join a club or a small contest. Feedback helps you grow.

Don't worry if your dream changes. A ten-year-old who loved dinosaurs may become a doctor, a writer, or a pilot. The important thing is to stay curious and keep walking. Your hobby today may light up your whole future.
lessons.cn:
十年后你会做什么工作？也许还不清楚——大多数青少年都一样。

找到自己道路的四步：

1) 尝试：运动、音乐、烹饪、编程、绘画……没试过就不知道爱不爱。

2) 聚焦：哪件事让心跳加速，就多花时间。起步一天一小时就够。

3) 学习：读书、看视频、请教老师。每个技能都有规律和技巧。

4) 分享：把作品给朋友看，参加社团或小比赛。反馈让你进步。

梦想变了也没关系。10 岁时喜欢恐龙的人，后来可能成为医生、作家或飞行员。重要的是保持好奇心，不停前进——今日的爱好，或许会点亮你整个未来。

words.example: I looked up the word in an encyclopaedia.
This encyclopaedia has 20 volumes.
The book gives useful information.
History is an interesting subject.
Knowledge is power.
Search online for more details.
I read an article on pandas.
Choose an interesting topic.
Use the index to find keywords.
Wikipedia is a popular website.
Please give me more details.
Computers search data quickly.
The book includes 5000 pictures.
The book was published in 2020.
Many experts wrote the articles.

lessons.title: Reading · A treasure of knowledge
lessons.en:
Last weekend, my father took me to his old study. On the shelf, there were 20 big books. They were the Children's Encyclopaedia he got when he was a boy.

An encyclopaedia is a book that tries to tell you about everything — animals, plants, planets, countries, famous people. Each article is short but clear. The books have an index at the end, so we can find any topic in a few seconds.

I opened Volume 5 and read about the moon. I learned that the moon is 384,000 kilometres from the Earth, and there is no air on it. Then I opened Volume 12 and learned about dinosaurs.

An encyclopaedia is like a small library. I can travel the world and visit the stars without leaving home. It is truly a treasure of knowledge.
lessons.cn:
上周末，爸爸带我去他的老书房。书架上有 20 本大书，是他小时候得到的《儿童百科全书》。

百科全书几乎包罗万象——动物、植物、行星、国家、名人，每一篇文章都简短清晰。书末有索引，几秒就能查到任何主题。

我翻到第 5 卷读月球：月亮距地球 38.4 万公里，上面没有空气。又翻到第 12 卷读恐龙。

百科全书就像一座小图书馆，足不出户就能周游世界、遨游星空，真是知识的宝藏。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · How to ask questions
lessons.en:
Five useful question words: what / who / where / when / why / how.

What is an encyclopaedia?
— It is a book that tells you about many subjects.

Who writes the articles?
— Many experts from different fields write them.

Where can we find the word list?
— We can find it in the index at the end.

When was the first encyclopaedia published?
— About two thousand years ago in ancient Rome.

Why do students read encyclopaedias?
— Because they want quick and clear information.

How do you search for a topic?
— You look up the key word in the index first.
lessons.cn:
五个常用疑问词：what / who / where / when / why / how。

百科全书是什么？
——它是介绍各种主题的书。

谁写文章？
——来自各领域的专家。

词表在哪里？
——在书末的索引里。

第一本百科全书何时出版？
——约两千年前在古罗马。

学生为什么读百科全书？
——因为能快速获得清晰信息。

怎样查主题？
——先在索引里查关键词。

lessons.title: More reading · From paper to the Internet
lessons.en:
Encyclopaedias have a long history. Two thousand years ago, a Roman writer called Pliny wrote a 37-volume book about everything he knew. It is the oldest encyclopaedia in the world.

In the 18th century, French scholars worked together for 25 years to publish 28 volumes, bringing knowledge to ordinary people.

Today, we read encyclopaedias on the Internet. Wikipedia was started in 2001 and now has over 6 million articles in English alone. It is free, and anyone can write or correct an article.

But be careful — not everything on the Internet is true. Always check more than one website. A good reader uses both paper books and online pages, and thinks before believing.
lessons.cn:
百科全书历史悠久。2000 年前，古罗马作家普林尼写下 37 卷涵盖所有他所知事物的巨著，是世界最古老的百科全书。

18 世纪，法国学者合作 25 年出版 28 卷大百科，把知识送到普通人手中。

今天我们在网上读百科全书。维基百科 2001 年创立，英文版已超 600 万条，免费且人人可编辑。

但要当心——网上信息不一定都真实，多查几个网站才靠谱。好的读者既看纸质书也看网页，学会思考后再相信。

words.example: Seven is a lucky number in China.
Let's count from one to ten.
Over one billion people speak Chinese.
The city has four million people.
A thousand years is very long.
There are one hundred students.
Two plus two is equal to four.
Three plus five is eight.
Ten minus three is seven.
Multiply four by five to get twenty.
Divide ten by two and you get five.
I like math lessons.
Eight is a lucky number.
Ancient Chinese invented paper.
Li is a common family name.

lessons.title: Reading · Numbers in our life
lessons.en:
Numbers are everywhere. They tell the time, the price, the phone number and even the temperature.

The most common numbers are from zero to nine. With these ten digits we can write any number — from one to a billion and more. The Chinese people began to use the ten-digit system more than 3,000 years ago.

Different people like different numbers. In China, eight is a lucky number because it sounds like "getting rich". In the West, seven is lucky because there are seven days in a week and seven colours in a rainbow. But 13 is often seen as unlucky, so many buildings have no 13th floor.

Without numbers, there would be no math, no computers, no smartphones. Learn to love numbers — they make our life easier.
lessons.cn:
数字无处不在：时间、价格、电话号码，甚至气温。

最常见的是 0~9 这十个数字，用它们我们能写出任意的数——从一到十亿乃至更大。中国人早在 3000 多年前就开始使用十进制。

不同文化有不同的幸运数字。在中国，“八”是吉祥数，因谐音“发”；在西方，“七”幸运——一周七天、彩虹七色。但 13 常被视为不吉利，许多大楼没有 13 层。

没有数字就没有数学、没有电脑、没有手机。热爱数字吧，它让生活更简单。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Big numbers in English
lessons.en:
Read these numbers carefully:
100 — a hundred / one hundred
1,000 — a thousand / one thousand
10,000 — ten thousand
100,000 — one hundred thousand
1,000,000 — one million
1,000,000,000 — one billion

More examples:
386 — three hundred and eighty-six
2,500 — two thousand five hundred
32,000 — thirty-two thousand
1,400,000 — one point four million

Tips:
- Add "and" after "hundred" in British English: three hundred AND six.
- Use singular forms after numbers: two hundred, three million, four billion (no -s).
- With "of", use plural: thousands of people, millions of books.
lessons.cn:
英语大数的读法：
100 —— a hundred
1,000 —— a thousand
10,000 —— ten thousand
100,000 —— one hundred thousand
1,000,000 —— one million
1,000,000,000 —— one billion

更多例子：
386 —— three hundred and eighty-six
2,500 —— two thousand five hundred
32,000 —— thirty-two thousand
140 万 —— one point four million

小贴士：
- 英式英语 hundred 后加 and：three hundred AND six。
- 具体数字后 hundred/million/billion 不加 s。
- 与 of 连用时加 s：thousands of people, millions of books。

lessons.title: More reading · The story of zero
lessons.en:
Can you imagine numbers without zero? It is hard.

The ancient Greeks had no zero. They wrote 102 as "one hundred two" and could not easily show that the tens place was empty. That made math very slow.

Around 1,500 years ago, Indian scholars invented a small round symbol — 0 — to mean "nothing". This small symbol changed the world. With zero, we can write 10, 100, 1,000 quickly and do hard math easily.

An Arab traveller brought zero to Europe in the 9th century. At first, people didn't trust it. How can nothing be a number? But scientists proved that zero was necessary. Today, zero is the base of all modern math and computer science — computers use only two numbers, 0 and 1.

Sometimes the smallest idea is the greatest gift.
lessons.cn:
你能想象没有“零”的数字世界吗？很难。

古希腊人没有零，他们把 102 写作“一百二”，没法清楚表示十位空缺，数学进展缓慢。

约 1500 年前，印度学者发明了一个小圆圈——0——表示“什么也没有”。这个小符号改变了世界：有了零，我们才能快速写出 10、100、1000，也能轻松做复杂运算。

9 世纪阿拉伯旅行者把零带到欧洲。起初人们不信：“无”怎能是数？但科学家证明零不可或缺。如今零是现代数学和计算机科学的基础——计算机只用 0 和 1 两个数。

最小的想法，有时正是最伟大的礼物。

lessons.title: Reading · My first computer
lessons.en:
I got my first computer last year for my thirteenth birthday. It was a small laptop, only 1.5 kilograms. I was so excited!

Dad showed me how to turn it on. The screen lit up and asked me to set a password. I chose one that I could remember. Then I learned how to use the mouse and keyboard.

On the first day, I typed a short letter to my grandma. It took me thirty minutes — I could only find one letter at a time! A week later, I could type much faster. I also learned to save my files in different folders: "homework", "music", "photos".

Now I use the computer every day. I write stories, watch English videos, and email my cousin in America. My world has become bigger. But I remember Dad's words: a computer is a tool — don't let it use you.
lessons.cn:
去年 13 岁生日，我得到了人生第一台电脑，是个 1.5 公斤的小笔记本，我激动极了！

爸爸教我开机，屏幕亮了要求设密码——我选了一个容易记的。又学了用鼠标、键盘。

第一天我给奶奶打了一封短信，花了半小时，只能一个字母一个字母找。一周后我打字快多了，还学会把文件放进不同文件夹：“作业”、“音乐”、“照片”。

现在我每天用电脑写故事、看英语视频，还给在美国的表姐发邮件。我的世界变大了。但我记得爸爸的话：电脑是工具，别让它反过来用你。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · How to give instructions
lessons.en:
To give clear instructions, use the imperative form: verb first, no subject.

Turn on the computer.
Open the program.
Click the mouse.
Type your password.
Save the file.
Close the window.
Shut down the computer.

To give a negative instruction, use "Don't":
Don't share your password.
Don't download strange files.
Don't use the computer for too long.

To be polite, add "please":
Please click here.
Please enter your name.
Would you please save the file?

Order matters — steps usually follow "first, then, next, finally":
First, turn on the computer. Then, enter the password. Next, click the browser. Finally, search for the website.
lessons.cn:
清晰的指令用祈使句——动词开头，不加主语：
开机。
打开程序。
点击鼠标。
输入密码。
保存文件。
关闭窗口。
关机。

否定用 Don't：
别分享密码。
别下载可疑文件。
别用电脑太久。

礼貌加 please：
请点击这里。
请输入姓名。
能保存下文件吗？

步骤用 first / then / next / finally：
首先开机 → 然后输密码 → 接下来点浏览器 → 最后搜索网站。

lessons.title: More reading · Safe on the Internet
lessons.en:
The Internet is like a huge city. It is full of wonderful places — but also a few dangerous streets. Here are five rules to stay safe:

1) Keep your password secret. Never tell anyone, even your best friend. Change it every few months.

2) Think before you click. A strange email or a free-gift pop-up may carry a virus. If you are not sure, don't click it.

3) Protect your private information. Never write your home address, phone number or school name on public websites.

4) Be kind online. Unkind words hurt people just as much on a screen as in real life.

5) Balance your time. An hour at the computer should be followed by ten minutes of rest. Go outside and look at something green — your eyes will thank you.

The Internet is a tool. Use it wisely, and it will open a bright and wide world for you.
lessons.cn:
互联网像一座巨大的城市，有美好的景点，也有危险的街道。五条安全守则：

1) 密码保密——永远不告诉任何人（包括好朋友），每隔几个月换一次。

2) 点击前思考——可疑邮件、免费礼物弹窗可能带病毒，没把握就别点。

3) 保护隐私——家庭地址、电话、学校名绝不写在公开网站上。

4) 网络友善——屏幕上的恶语和现实中一样伤人。

5) 控制时间——每用 1 小时休息 10 分钟，看看窗外的绿色，眼睛会感谢你。

互联网只是工具，用得好就能为你打开广阔的世界。

words.example: The light bulb was a great invention.
Edison was a famous inventor.
Newton discovered gravity.
Washing machines save time.
Steam engines changed the world.
Steam rose from the pot.
Modern life is fast.
History teaches us lessons.
The 21st century is full of change.
Inventions change our life.
Paper was invented in China.
The compass guides sailors.
Printing spread knowledge quickly.
Gunpowder came from ancient China.
A useful tool helps us every day.

lessons.title: Reading · Four great inventions
lessons.en:
Do you know the Four Great Inventions of ancient China? They are paper, the compass, printing and gunpowder. Each one changed the world.

Paper was invented in China about two thousand years ago. Before paper, people wrote on bamboo or silk. Bamboo was heavy and silk was expensive. Paper was light and cheap, so knowledge could travel far.

The compass was another great gift. It uses a magnetic needle that always points north. Sailors could now find their way on the open sea.

Printing made books cheap and common. Before printing, every book was copied by hand, and only rich people could buy them. After printing, more children could read.

Gunpowder was first used in medicine, then in fireworks, and later in warfare.

These four inventions flew from China to Europe along the Silk Road. They pushed the world into a new age.
lessons.cn:
你知道中国古代四大发明吗？造纸术、指南针、印刷术、火药——每一项都改变了世界。

造纸术约 2000 年前发明于中国。此前人们在竹简或丝绸上书写，竹子沉重、丝绸昂贵；纸又轻又便宜，知识才能传得远。

指南针借助磁针永远指北，水手从此能在大海上辨认方向。

印刷术让书变得便宜普及。此前每本书都靠手抄，只有富人买得起；印刷之后，更多孩子能读书。

火药先用于医药，后用于烟花，再后来用于战争。

这四大发明沿丝绸之路传到欧洲，把世界推向新的时代。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Passive voice with by
lessons.en:
Passive voice: be + past participle. Use "by" to show who did the action (the doer).

Paper was invented by the Chinese.
The light bulb was invented by Edison.
Hundreds of useful machines were made by this factory.
Are the books printed by hand? — No, they are printed by machines.
When was the compass invented? — It was invented more than 2,000 years ago.

Tenses:
Present passive: is / are + pp — The letter is written by hand.
Past passive: was / were + pp — The letter was written by hand.
Future passive: will be + pp — The new computer will be sold next year.

Omit "by …" when the doer is unknown or not important:
The book was published last year. (we don't need to say "by who")
lessons.cn:
被动语态：be + 过去分词；用 by 指出动作发出者。

纸由中国人发明。
灯泡由爱迪生发明。
这家工厂生产了数百种有用机器。
书是手抄的吗？——不，是机器印的。
指南针何时发明？——两千多年前发明的。

时态：
一般现在：is/are+pp——这封信是手写的。
一般过去：was/were+pp——这封信是手写的（过去）。
一般将来：will be+pp——新电脑明年将出售。

动作发出者不重要时省略 by：
这本书去年出版。

lessons.title: More reading · Invent for the future
lessons.en:
Inventions are not only for grown-ups. Many famous inventors started as children with a question: "Can I make this better?"

Louis Braille lost his sight at the age of three. As a student, he designed a special way of writing with small dots. Today, blind people all over the world read books in Braille.

Philo Farnsworth, a 14-year-old American farm boy, drew his first design of the television on a school blackboard. Twenty years later, his idea became real.

At your age, you can also invent. You don't need a big lab — a notebook, a pencil and an open mind are enough.

Look around your home. What is slow, heavy or wasteful? Think: how can I make it faster, lighter or cleaner? Share your idea with teachers and friends. Who knows — your invention might one day help millions of people.
lessons.cn:
发明并非大人的专利。许多著名发明家小时候就提出过这样的问题：“我能不能让它更好？”

布莱尔 3 岁失明，上学时设计出由小点组成的盲文，如今全世界盲人都通过它读书。

美国 14 岁农场男孩法恩斯沃斯在学校黑板上画出人类首张电视设计图，20 年后梦想成真。

你在你这个年纪也能发明。不必大实验室——一本笔记本、一支铅笔、一颗好奇心足矣。

环顾家中：什么又慢又重又浪费？想一想：怎样让它更快、更轻、更环保？把想法告诉老师和朋友。谁知道呢——你的发明也许有一天能帮助千百万人。

words.example: I have a good memory for songs.
I remember my first day at school.
Don't forget to close the window.
An active mind stays young.
Sleep helps your brain rest.
Review your notes before bed.
Repeat the words three times.
Find a good method to study.
Here is a memory trick.
Images help us remember.
Draw a picture for each word.
Concentrate on your reading.
Phones distract students.
We have a quiz every Friday.
Practice improves memory.

lessons.title: Reading · How to remember better
lessons.en:
Have you ever learned a word in the morning and forgotten it by night? Don't worry — it happens to everyone. The good news is that memory is like a muscle. The more you train it, the stronger it grows.

Here are three simple tricks I use:

1) Repeat with space. I review a new word five minutes later, then one hour, one day, and one week. Each time the word goes deeper into my mind.

2) Make a picture. For the word "elephant", I imagine a pink elephant riding a bicycle. The crazier the picture, the harder it is to forget.

3) Tell a friend. When I explain a rule to my little brother, I understand it twice as well.

My English teacher says, "Your brain is not a warehouse, it is a garden. Water it every day, and the flowers will bloom."
lessons.cn:
你是否早上记的单词晚上就忘？别担心——人人如此。好消息是：记忆像肌肉，越练越强。

三个简单小技巧：

1) 间隔重复。学了新词 5 分钟后复习一次，再 1 小时、1 天、1 周后各一次，词就深入脑海。

2) 编画面。记 elephant 时我想象一只粉色大象骑自行车——越夸张越难忘。

3) 讲给别人。我给弟弟讲一条规则时，自己理解会加倍。

英语老师常说：“大脑不是仓库，而是花园，天天浇水，花自然开。”

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Adverbs of degree
lessons.en:
Adverbs of degree tell us "how much".

Very / really → strong:
I am very tired.
This book is really interesting.

Quite / pretty → fairly strong (British/American):
Her memory is quite good.
The test was pretty easy.

A bit / a little → small amount:
I am a bit tired.
Please speak a little louder.

Too / enough → opposite idea:
Too = more than needed: The homework is too difficult.
Enough = as much as needed (after adjective): I am old enough to read this book.

Compare:
She runs fast. (no degree)
She runs very fast. (strong degree)
She runs a little too fast. (slightly more than needed)
lessons.cn:
程度副词表示“多少”。

very / really——非常：
我非常累。
这本书真有趣。

quite / pretty——相当（英式/美式）：
她的记忆力相当好。
考试相当简单。

a bit / a little——有点：
我有点累。
请说大声一点。

too / enough——对比：
too 表“太过”：作业太难了。
enough 放形容词后表“足够”：我已经长到可以读这书了。

对比：
她跑得快（无程度）
她跑得非常快（强）
她跑得稍微有点太快（比需要的略快）

lessons.title: More reading · Champions of memory
lessons.en:
Every year, people from over thirty countries join the World Memory Championships. They try to memorise names, numbers and cards in a very short time. The winners have amazing skills.

Alex Mullen from the USA can remember a random list of 3,000 numbers in one hour. His secret? He changes numbers into pictures. 12 might be a goldfish, 34 might be a dragon. Then he puts them on a road he knows very well — his street, his school, his living room. When he wants to remember, he just "walks" along the road.

Scientists tell us that memory champions don't have special brains. They have special methods and strong practice. They train every day, often three or four hours.

You can borrow their tricks. Next time you learn twenty new words, turn them into funny pictures and put them in a room you know. In a few weeks, the words will come to you easily — just like old friends.
lessons.cn:
每年三十多国选手参加世界记忆大赛，在极短时间内记姓名、数字和扑克。冠军的技艺令人叹服。

美国选手艾历克斯·马伦能在一小时记 3000 个随机数字。秘诀？他把数字变成图像：12 是金鱼、34 是龙，然后把它们沿着自己熟悉的街道、校园、客厅摆放。回忆时就“沿路走一遍”。

科学家说记忆冠军并非大脑特殊，而是方法特殊 + 苦练。他们每天练 3~4 小时。

你也可借鉴：下次记 20 个新词，编成搞笑图像放进熟悉的房间里。几周后，这些词就会像老朋友一样主动来找你。

words.example: Ancient Greeks loved stories.
The Monkey King is a Chinese legend.
Greek myths are full of gods.
He is a hero of the village.
The king ruled wisely.
The queen loved her people.
A fierce battle was fought here.
Chinese dragons bring good luck.
Greek gods lived on Mount Olympus.
The monkey uses magic tricks.
The brave young man saved the village.
Sun Wukong is a clever monkey.
The Emperor built a great wall.
A dark castle stood on the hill.
His journey lasted ten years.

lessons.title: Reading · The Monkey King
lessons.en:
Sun Wukong, also called the Monkey King, is one of the most loved heroes in Chinese stories. He was born from a stone on the Flower-Fruit Mountain. From the first day he was brave, clever and full of magic.

Sun Wukong learned 72 changes. He could turn himself into a tiger, a fish, or even a small fly. He also had a long gold stick that could grow as tall as the sky or shrink to the size of a needle.

In the famous story Journey to the West, Sun Wukong goes with the monk Tang Sanzang to bring Buddhist books back from India. The journey takes more than ten years. They meet eighty-one dangers on the way — demons, mountains of fire, and tricky spirits. But with courage and cleverness, Sun Wukong protects his master every time.

Why do children love Sun Wukong? Because he is not a perfect hero. He is naughty and proud, but he is also loyal and kind. He reminds us that a true hero is brave, clever and faithful to friends.
lessons.cn:
孙悟空，又名美猴王，是中国故事里最受喜爱的英雄之一。他在花果山从石头里蹦出，从第一天起便勇敢、聪明、法力高强。

孙悟空学了 72 变，可化作老虎、鱼，甚至小小苍蝇；他手里的金箍棒能大如天、小如针。

在《西游记》里，他陪唐僧去西天取经，十余年路上遭遇 81 难：妖怪、火焰山、狡诈之灵。凭着勇气和机智，悟空次次护师平安。

为什么孩子们爱孙悟空？因为他不是完美英雄——顽皮又骄傲，却忠诚善良。他让我们明白：真正的英雄勇敢、聪明，对朋友忠诚。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Past perfect tense
lessons.en:
Past perfect: had + past participle. Use it for an action that happened BEFORE another past action.

When the soldiers arrived, the Emperor had already left.
By the time we got there, the movie had started.
She had never seen the sea before she was ten.

Compare with simple past:
I got home at 7. I had finished my homework at 6.
(First: finished homework at 6. Then: got home at 7.)

Common signal words: before, after, by the time, already, just, never ... before, when.

Questions and negatives:
Had you met him before? — Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
They hadn't read the story before the teacher told it.
lessons.cn:
过去完成时：had + 过去分词，表过去某动作之前已发生的事。

士兵到达时，皇帝已经离开了。
我们到时电影已经开始了。
她十岁前从没见过大海。

与一般过去时对比：
我 7 点到家，6 点前就写完了作业。
（先：6 点前写完。再：7 点到家。）

常用提示词：before / after / by the time / already / just / never … before / when。

疑问和否定：
之前见过他吗？——见过。/ 没见过。
老师讲之前他们没读过这个故事。

lessons.title: More reading · Stories from Greece
lessons.en:
Far away, in ancient Greece, people also told wonderful stories. Their gods lived on Mount Olympus, a tall snowy mountain.

The king of the gods was Zeus. He could throw lightning like a spear. His wife Hera protected families. His brother Poseidon ruled the sea, and his daughter Athena taught people wisdom.

One famous story is about a hero called Odysseus. After winning a ten-year war, he wanted to sail home. But the sea god was angry with him. Storms, one-eyed giants, and a witch made his trip last another ten years! When he finally came home, his wife and son had waited for him for twenty years.

Greek stories teach us lessons: brave people never give up; clever people solve problems; kind people are remembered forever.

Chinese stories and Greek stories come from different countries, but they share the same message — be brave, be clever, and be true.
lessons.cn:
遥远的古希腊也有精彩的故事。诸神居于高雪覆盖的奥林匹斯山。

众神之王宙斯能掷闪电如标枪；妻子赫拉守护家庭；弟弟波塞冬掌管大海；女儿雅典娜传授人智慧。

一则著名故事关于英雄奥德修斯：他打赢十年之战后欲返家，但海神愤怒，风暴、独眼巨人、女巫让他又漂泊十年！归家时妻儿已等他 20 年。

希腊故事教我们：勇者从不放弃；智者解决困难；善者被永久铭记。

中国故事与希腊故事来自不同国度，却传递相同的讯息——要勇敢、要聪明、要真诚。

words.example: Autumn is my favourite season.
The climate here is warm.
The weather today is sunny.
The temperature is 30°C.
Thunder frightens the dog.
A big storm came at night.
Guangzhou has typhoons in summer.
The fog is thick this morning.
Beijing is dry in winter.
The ground is wet after rain.
It is 25 degrees today.
Harbin is a northern city.
Guangzhou is in southern China.
Listen to the weather forecast.
Rainfall is heavy in summer.

lessons.title: Reading · Two cities, two worlds
lessons.en:
China is a big country, and its weather is very different from north to south. Let's compare two cities — Harbin in the north and Guangzhou in the south.

In Harbin, winter lasts more than five months. From November to March, the temperature often falls below zero. The rivers freeze, and children skate on the ice. Every January, Harbin holds a famous Ice Festival. Huge buildings made of ice shine like crystal under the lights.

In Guangzhou, winter is short and mild. Even in January, we seldom see snow. People wear jackets, not heavy coats. But summer is hot and wet. From May to September, storms and typhoons come one after another. When a typhoon arrives, schools close and planes cannot fly.

Two cities, two worlds. But people in both places find joy. A northern child laughs on the ice, and a southern child jumps in the summer rain.
lessons.cn:
中国幅员辽阔，南北天气差异巨大。以北方哈尔滨和南方广州为例：

哈尔滨冬天长达 5 个多月。11 月到次年 3 月，气温常在零度以下，江河结冰，孩子们在冰上滑行。每年 1 月哈尔滨都举办著名的冰雪节——巨型冰雕在灯光下晶莹剔透。

广州冬天短暂温和，一月也很少下雪，人们穿夹克而非厚棉袄；但夏天炎热潮湿，5~9 月暴雨台风接连而至，台风一来学校停课、飞机停飞。

两座城，两种世界。但两地的人都自得其乐：北方孩子在冰上欢笑，南方孩子在夏雨里跳跃。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Comparatives and superlatives
lessons.en:
Comparative (two things): adj + er / more + adj + than
Winter in Harbin is colder than in Guangzhou.
Typhoons are more dangerous than summer rain.
This storm is worse than the last one. (bad→worse)

Superlative (three or more): the + adj + est / the most + adj
Harbin has the coldest winter in China.
This is the most interesting season of the year.
August is the hottest month here.

Irregular forms:
good → better → the best
bad → worse → the worst
many/much → more → the most
little → less → the least
far → farther → the farthest

Useful patterns:
as + adj + as: Guangzhou is as big as Shanghai.
not as + adj + as: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
the + comparative..., the + comparative: The colder, the better.
lessons.cn:
比较级（两者比较）：adj + er 或 more + adj，后接 than。
哈尔滨冬天比广州冷。
台风比夏雨更危险。
这次暴风比上次更糟。(bad→worse)

最高级（三者或以上）：the + adj + est 或 the most + adj。
哈尔滨冬天是中国最冷的。
这是一年中最有趣的季节。
八月是这里最热的月份。

不规则变化：
good → better → the best
bad → worse → the worst
many/much → more → the most
little → less → the least
far → farther → the farthest

常用句型：
as + adj + as：广州和上海一样大。
not as + adj + as：今天不如昨天热。
the + 比较级, the + 比较级：越冷越好。

lessons.title: More reading · A warming world
lessons.en:
Our planet is changing. Scientists tell us that the Earth is about one degree warmer today than one hundred years ago. One degree sounds small, but it makes a big difference.

Glaciers at the North and South Poles are melting. Sea levels are rising. Some low islands in the Pacific are already under water.

The seasons are also changing. Spring comes earlier, winter is shorter, and storms are stronger. Last summer, floods hit many cities in Europe, and heavy fires burned forests in Australia.

Why is this happening? We are burning too much coal, oil and gas. These fuels release gases that trap the sun's heat.

What can we do? Walk or cycle instead of driving. Save electricity at home. Plant trees every spring. Eat less meat. These small actions, if everyone does them, can cool our world again.

We only have one Earth. Protecting her seasons is protecting ourselves.
lessons.cn:
地球正在改变。科学家告诉我们，如今气温比一百年前高约 1℃。一度听来不多，影响却巨大：

南北极冰川在融化，海平面在上升，太平洋一些低洼岛屿已经被淹。

季节也在变——春天来得更早，冬天更短，风暴更强。去年夏天欧洲多城遭洪水，澳洲大火焚林。

原因？我们烧了太多煤、油、气。这些燃料排出温室气体，困住阳光的热量。

我们能做什么？短途步行或骑车，别开车；节约家里用电；每年春天植树；少吃肉。看似微小，人人坚持，地球就能重新变凉。

只有一个地球。保护它的四季，就是保护我们自己。

words.example: English is a world language.
She gave a short speech.
We performed a play in class.
I won the spelling contest.
The audience cheered loudly.
It was a wonderful performance.
Don't be nervous on stage.
She won the first prize.
There was a fierce competition.
Practise your lines every day.
Be confident when you speak.
I was nervous before the speech.
What role will you play?
Loud applause filled the hall.
The teachers organised the week.

lessons.title: Reading · Our English week
lessons.en:
Last week was English Week at our school. Five wonderful days, full of English everywhere!

Monday — Opening ceremony. Our headmaster gave a short welcome speech in English. Every classroom door had a new name: Ocean Room, Star Room, Rainbow Room.

Tuesday — Reading day. Students brought their favourite English books to share. I showed my Harry Potter. A boy from Class 3 brought The Little Prince.

Wednesday — Speaking contest. Twenty students each gave a three-minute speech. I was number twelve. I was so nervous that my knees shook, but the audience clapped when I finished.

Thursday — Play night. Our class performed a short play of The Tortoise and the Hare. I played the tortoise. Everyone laughed and cheered.

Friday — Prize day. My speech won third prize! I took home a book and a shining medal.

English is not only a subject. It is a bridge that connects me to a bigger world.
lessons.cn:
上周是我校英语周，五天活动精彩纷呈！

周一——开幕式。校长致英语欢迎辞，每间教室门上都换了新名字：海洋室、星星室、彩虹室。

周二——阅读日。同学们把最爱的英文书带来分享。我带了《哈利·波特》，三班一个男生带了《小王子》。

周三——演讲比赛。20 名选手每人三分钟。我是 12 号，紧张得膝盖都在抖，结束时观众热烈鼓掌。

周四——话剧之夜。我们班演《龟兔赛跑》，我扮演乌龟，全场欢笑欢呼。

周五——颁奖日。我的演讲得了三等奖！带回家一本书和一枚闪亮奖牌。

英语不止是一门学科，更是连接我和更大世界的桥梁。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Reported speech
lessons.en:
Direct speech uses quotation marks. Reported (indirect) speech changes the tense and pronouns.

Direct: He says, "I am nervous."
Reported: He says (that) he is nervous.

When the reporting verb is past, change the tense back one step:
Direct: She said, "I am tired."
Reported: She said (that) she was tired.

Direct: "I will help you," he said.
Reported: He said he would help me.

Direct: "I have won the prize," she told me.
Reported: She told me she had won the prize.

Questions in reported speech use statement word order:
Direct: He asked, "Where is the stage?"
Reported: He asked where the stage was.
Direct: She asked, "Do you like English?"
Reported: She asked if/whether I liked English.

Pronouns and time words also change:
today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.
lessons.cn:
直接引语用引号；间接引语要变时态和人称。

直接：他说：“我很紧张。”
间接：他说他很紧张。

主句若为过去时，从句时态退后一步：
直接：她说：“我累。”
间接：她说她累了。

直接：“我会帮你。”他说。
间接：他说他会帮我。

直接：“我赢了奖。”她告诉我。
间接：她告诉我她赢了奖。

间接问句用陈述语序：
直接：他问：“舞台在哪？”
间接：他问舞台在哪里。
直接：她问：“你喜欢英语吗？”
间接：她问我是否喜欢英语（用 if / whether）。

人称和时间状语也要变：
today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there。

lessons.title: More reading · Tips for a good speech
lessons.en:
Are you preparing for a speech or a play? Here are five tips from my English teacher:

1) Know your topic. Read a lot about it. The more you know, the more confident you are.

2) Write a simple plan. Start with a story or a question. State your main idea. Give two or three examples. End with a strong sentence the audience will remember.

3) Practise out loud. Stand in front of a mirror. Use your voice, face and hands. Record yourself — listen and improve.

4) Don't be afraid of mistakes. Even famous speakers make small mistakes. Smile and keep going.

5) Look at your audience. Pick three friendly faces — one on the left, one in the middle, one on the right. Look at them in turn while you speak.

A good speech is not only about English, but about your courage. Every time you stand on the stage, you grow a little taller.
lessons.cn:
你在准备演讲或话剧吗？英语老师分享 5 条秘诀：

1) 熟悉主题。多读相关资料，了解越多，越自信。

2) 写简单提纲：用故事或问题开场→说出中心思想→举 2~3 个例子→最后用有力的一句收尾，让观众记住。

3) 大声练习。对着镜子，用语调、表情、手势。录下来听听，不断改进。

4) 别怕出错。名家也会小失误，笑一下继续。

5) 看着观众。挑三张友好的脸——左、中、右各一——轮流注视他们讲话。

好的演讲不仅是英语的展示，更是勇气的考验。每一次站上舞台，你都会长高一点点。

lessons.title: Reading · A weekend at the Sunshine Home
lessons.en:
Every second Saturday, our school volunteer group visits the Sunshine Home, where twenty elderly people live.

Last weekend I went there for the first time. Grandma Li held my hand with a big smile, and I felt warm at once. We cleaned the windows and swept the floor. My friend Amy played the violin, and everyone clapped. I read a story to Grandpa Wang because his eyes were weak. He said, “Your voice is like my granddaughter's. Thank you, child.”

At lunch, we made dumplings together. Grandma Li's hands were slow but her smile was bright. When we left, I felt the happiest I had been all month. I learned that helping others is really a gift we give to ourselves.
lessons.cn:
每两周的周六，我校志愿者小组都会去“阳光之家”——住着二十位老人的小楼。

上周末我第一次去。李奶奶握住我的手微笑，我顿时觉得温暖。我们擦窗、扫地，朋友 Amy 拉小提琴，大家鼓掌。我给王爷爷读了故事，他说：“你的声音像我孙女，谢谢你，孩子。”

午饭我们一起包饺子。李奶奶手慢但笑容灿烂。离开时我感到是那个月最快乐的一天。我明白了：助人其实是送给自己的礼物。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Infinitives of purpose
lessons.en:
Use “to + verb” to say WHY you do something.
We visit the Sunshine Home to help the elderly.
She saved money to buy her mum a gift.
I came here to learn English.

More formal: in order to / so as to.
We collected old books in order to donate them.
He studies hard so as to enter a good school.

Negative: in order not to / so as not to.
She walks quietly so as not to wake the baby.
I took a map in order not to get lost.

Note: “for + verb-ing” is NOT used for purpose.
✗ I came for learning English.
✓ I came to learn English.
But “for + noun” is fine: I came for English lessons.
lessons.cn:
to + 动词表目的（做某事的原因）。
我们去“阳光之家”是为了帮助老人。
她省钱是为了给妈妈买礼物。
我来这里是为了学英语。

更正式：in order to / so as to。
我们收旧书以便捐赠。
他努力学习以便进入好学校。

否定：in order not to / so as not to。
她走路轻，以免吵醒婴儿。
我带了地图，以免迷路。

注意：表目的不能用 for + v-ing。
✗ I came for learning English.
✓ I came to learn English.
但 for + 名词可以：I came for English lessons.（来上英语课）

lessons.title: More reading · A long life of giving
lessons.en:
Madam Li is 92, but she still goes to school every day — not to learn, but to teach.

When she was young, there was no school in her village. She walked ten kilometres to town to study. At sixteen, she became a teacher and returned to her village. For fifty years she taught hundreds of children.

After retirement, she and her husband used their savings to build a small library in the village. It opened at 7 a.m. and closed at 7 p.m. Children could borrow any book for free. Ten years ago her husband passed away. She said, “I must keep the library open. That was our dream.”

Today the library has over 12,000 books. Many village children who grew up reading here now study in universities. Madam Li says, “The greatest gift is to pass a little light to someone else.”
lessons.cn:
李奶奶 92 岁了，但她每天仍去学校——不是去学，而是去教。

年轻时她村里没学校，她每天步行十公里到镇上念书。16 岁当上老师回到村子，教了 50 年书，教过数百个孩子。

退休后，她和丈夫用积蓄在村里建了一座小图书馆，每天清晨 7 点开门、晚上 7 点关门，孩子可免费借任何书。十年前丈夫去世，她说：“这图书馆我必须守下去，那是我们共同的梦。”

如今馆藏超过 1.2 万册，许多从这里读书长大的孩子正在读大学。李奶奶说：“最伟大的礼物，是把一点光亮传给别人。”

lessons.title: Reading · When words are not enough
lessons.en:
Sometimes we do not need to speak — our body speaks for us. When you meet a friend, you smile. When you agree, you nod. When a ball comes at you, you shout “Watch out!” with open hands more than with words. This is body language.

Our face is a small stage. It shows if we are happy, tired, worried or angry. A real smile travels across countries, and even babies understand it.

Our hands are busy actors. We use them to point, to count, to say hello or goodbye. A warm handshake starts a friendship. A gentle pat on the shoulder says, “You did a good job.”

Body language is the first language we ever learn. We use it long before we speak. And even when we grow up, it never stops talking for us.
lessons.cn:
有时我们不必开口，身体就替我们说话。见到朋友时你微笑；同意时你点头；球飞来时你摊开双手喊“小心！”——比开口更有力。这就是肢体语言。

脸是一座小舞台，告诉别人你快乐、疲倦、担忧还是生气。真诚的微笑跨越国界，婴儿也能读懂。

双手是忙碌的演员：指物、点数、打招呼、说再见。热情一握开启新友谊，轻拍肩膀代表“干得好”。

肢体语言是我们最早学会的语言，远早于开口说话。长大后，它也从未停止替我们发声。

lessons.title: Grammar focus · Linking words: so / because / but
lessons.en:
Linking words join two ideas into one clear sentence.

because — gives the REASON.
I smiled because I was happy.
He was tired because he had worked all day.

so — gives the RESULT.
I was happy, so I smiled.
She was tired, so she went to bed early.

but — shows a CONTRAST.
He nodded, but he did not agree.
The room was small but beautiful.

Rule: Do NOT use because and so together.
✗ Because I was tired, so I went home.
✓ Because I was tired, I went home.
✓ I was tired, so I went home.
lessons.cn:
连接词把两句合成一句通顺的话。

because——表原因：
我笑因为我开心。
他累因为他工作一天。

so——表结果：
我开心，所以我笑。
她累，所以早早睡了。

but——表转折：
他点头，但没同意。
房间小，但漂亮。

规则：because 和 so 不能同时用。
✗ 因为我累，所以我回家。
✓ 因为累，我回家。 / 我累，所以回家。

lessons.title: More reading · Gestures around the world
lessons.en:
The same gesture can mean different things in different places.

Thumbs up. In China and most Western countries, it means “good” or “well done”. But in some parts of the Middle East and West Africa, it is rude.

Nodding. In most countries, it means “yes”. But in Bulgaria and some parts of India, it can mean “no”, and shaking the head means “yes”.

OK sign (thumb and finger in a circle). Americans use it for “great”, but in Brazil and Turkey it is very rude.

Personal space. Italians and Spaniards stand close and often touch lightly. Japanese and Koreans prefer more space — a small bow is more polite than a hug.

So, when you visit a new country, learn a few local gestures. A little care saves a lot of trouble and opens many smiling faces.
lessons.cn:
同一手势在不同国家含义差别很大。

翘大拇指——中国和多数西方国家表示“好”、“棒”；但在中东和西非部分地区是粗鲁的。

点头——多数国家表“是”；但在保加利亚和印度某些地方，点头反而表“否”，摇头表“是”。

OK 手势（拇指食指围圈）——美国表“很棒”；但在巴西和土耳其很不礼貌。

个人空间——意大利和西班牙人聊天时常站得很近并轻拍身体；日本和韩国喜欢保持距离——小小的鞠躬比拥抱更得体。

出国前学几条当地手势——小小留心能避开大麻烦，也能赢来无数笑脸。
